name: Buffer weekly social-post queue
request: Write exactly one concise marketing email in English introducing Buffer to an owner or marketer at a small local business who plans social posts. Show a specific weekly workflow: queue a few posts across channels, then inspect basic post performance. Invite the reader to check the official plans and free entry. Do not presume their current tool, promise follower growth, or hide the free plan scheduling limits.
audience_segment: Independent local business planning social posts
